analysis_metadata.parser: original_source_parser; strict exact-button parser is descriptive only

bootstrap.array_encoding: group order; each (10000, group_count) C-order little-endian int64
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 95% percentile; not a qualification gate or population certainty
bootstrap.unit: Whole first context; retain all arms, both positions and both seeds together

schedule_comparison.interpretation: Coverage plus aggregate prefill exposure in this adapted model/assay; no equivalence or prior-Qwen3 explanation.

decision.stopping: No automatic alternative dose, site, anchor, parser, batch, model, or paid retry; narrow behavior cannot rescue full-mask qualification.

limitations: Source-parser categories are supplied by an independent audit; this function does not reparse tokens or verify GPU/source provenance.
Missing and execution-failed assignments retain their denominators and prevent admission; observed values do not certify absent responses.
Text clusters are a resampling unit, not proof of independent semantic worlds or population sampling.
The adapted Qwen2.5 assay does not establish pain specificity, experience, or the cause of unchanged-Qwen3 nulls.
